purpose: Supplement the main JNU data-source registry with newly verified substitute sources discovered after the mobile/local-data blocker review.

sources.coverage: Public sample 2026-02-01 through 2026-07-31; 177,893 rows according to upstream README
sources.license_or_terms_status: Repository LICENSE is MIT. Treat the public sample as proxy market data; keep raw upstream and persist only derived research panels/results in jerry-backtest-lab.
sources.jnu_role: Current-regime methodology/holdout stress tests for Nikkei/JNU candidates
sources.formal_limitation: Cannot establish OSE contract identity, futures microstructure, exact JNU execution or true-venue price discovery.

sources.data_type: True CME Nikkei 225 futures tick/1m/5m and higher bars
sources.coverage: Visible NKD intraday sample approximately 2026-03-08 through 2026-04-15
sources.license_or_terms_status: Source repository is public and identifies TopstepX/ProjectX as upstream. Raw redistribution rights are not assumed; prefer upstream references, hashes and derived results.
sources.jnu_role: CME-side venue alignment and DPD feasibility
sources.formal_limitation: Short sample and wrong venue for OSE/JNU promotion. Cannot prove OSE leadership or JNU execution.

sources.data_type: Official OSE historical tick data potentially provided for examination of trading methodology
sources.coverage: JPX states historical OSE tick data may be provided if certain conditions are met; exact Nikkei 225 mini/micro product/date coverage depends on approval.
sources.license_or_terms_status: Current JPX historical-data page confirms the free-trial path and directs enquiries to JPX Market Innovation & Research Client Services through the J-Quants DataCube contact form. The published operational-process document describes the applicant as a company and requests company/representative details; direct individual eligibility is therefore not established. Trial information must remain within the approved purpose and period.
sources.jnu_role: Potential official true-OSE source for HAR-RSV Stage A and frozen true-OSE intraday tests if eligibility and Nikkei coverage are approved.
sources.formal_limitation: Do not assume a retail individual can obtain the trial. Do not acquire, retain, cloud-process or redistribute trial data beyond terms explicitly approved by OSE.

sources.data_type: Official OSE tick and one-minute OHLC historical derivatives data
sources.coverage: Official documentation lists Nikkei 225 mini and Nikkei 225 micro derivatives histories and confirms futures one-minute/tick products exist; product-specific periods vary by dataset.
sources.license_or_terms_status: Official paid source. Retained only as identity/coverage reference under the current no-paid policy. JPX historical-data documentation explicitly states that sample files are available via the Sample Data button on each product page.
sources.jnu_role: Reference proving exact official true-OSE data granularity exists and a schema/sample path is available.
sources.formal_limitation: Do not purchase without explicit user authorization; sample files do not by themselves provide adequate history for formal validation. The DataCube product site returned 403 to the current web retrieval environment, so no sample bytes were acquired in this round.

sources.provider: Singapore Exchange / legacy public derivatives download path
sources.data_type: Historical SGX derivatives daily tick archives (WEBPXTICK_DT) plus structure and trade-code files
sources.coverage: Multiple open-source downloaders document date-indexed SGX history, with one project using a default start date of 2004-07-23. Exact current endpoint availability and Nikkei contract coverage still require direct verification.
sources.license_or_terms_status: SGX Data Direct states the latest Market Data Policy is effective 2026-07-01 and governs display, non-display, redistribution and reporting. Existence of legacy public files/downloaders does not establish current permission for bulk automated quantitative ingestion or cloud retention.
sources.current_contract_identity_evidence: Current SGX rulebook materials explicitly list Nikkei 225 Index Futures and Micro Nikkei 225 Index Futures; older/current rulebook material also identifies Mini Nikkei 225 Index Futures. This confirms venue/product identity but not historical archive codes or rights.
sources.jnu_role: Potential SGX venue source for DPD if current official access, Nikkei contract identity and quantitative-research rights are explicitly verified.
sources.formal_limitation: Do not bulk-download, scrape, automate or persist SGX raw market data in GitHub/cloud under current evidence. First obtain a current rights interpretation or explicit permission.

sources.data_type: SGX Nikkei 225 futures web history/current delayed intraday display and CSV export for displayed views
sources.coverage: Current-session delayed futures data and historical contract pages; free site members have limited CSV downloads
sources.license_or_terms_status: Free members are limited to one site download per day. This is not yet an approved automated historical intraday feed; do not scrape or treat as bulk source without terms review.
sources.jnu_role: Manual SGX identity/sanity checks and possible small legally reviewed sample acquisition
sources.formal_limitation: Does not yet satisfy matched-expiry long-history SGX intraday requirement for formal DPD.

sources.data_type: Daily historical Asian equity index futures CSV including Japan Nikkei futures
sources.coverage: Approximately 10 years of daily data used in 2020 study
sources.jnu_role: Longer-horizon daily futures proxy/cross-check and trend-method replication only
sources.formal_limitation: Daily data cannot replace OSE minute/tick data for HAR-RSV, intraday path, DPD or microstructure validation.

sources.data_type: Daily normalized futures returns and trend strengths across 24 markets including Nikkei 225
sources.license_or_terms_status: Public Mendeley dataset; verify exact license on download before durable reuse.
sources.jnu_role: Independent long-history daily trend/reversion methodology evidence
sources.formal_limitation: Normalized daily data are unsuitable for exact JNU execution, intraday volatility construction or venue price discovery.

sources.coverage: Historical bar infrastructure exists; public references indicate long intraday history.
sources.license_or_terms_status: Dukascopy Terms of Use prohibit scraper/robot/data-mining/automated acquisition of website data without prior express written consent.
sources.jnu_role: Potential proxy only after explicit permission/approved access route
sources.formal_limitation: Do not automate download in GitHub Actions under current terms review.

sources.data_type: OSE Nikkei 225 Mini futures daily OHLC/history display
sources.coverage: Daily historical table; not minute data
sources.license_or_terms_status: Use for manual/public-web cross-check only unless automated access/storage terms are separately approved.
sources.formal_limitation: Cannot replace minute data for HAR-RSV true-OSE confirmation or FIRST/LAST-30m path tests.

sources.license_or_terms_status: FRED marks SP500 copyrighted/pre-approval-required. FRED terms also prohibit AI-related use and storing/caching API content in the cited current terms. Do not use it in the cloud research pipeline without separate permission.
sources.jnu_role: Exact literature predictor conceptually, but not adopted for automated cloud holdout under current rights policy

sources.data_type: SPY daily bars used only as an S&P 500 cash-market proxy
sources.license_or_terms_status: Do not durably archive raw Yahoo response. Fetch transiently for an explicitly proxy-only research family and persist only derived predictor returns/provenance.
sources.jnu_role: Proxy-of-predictor for current-regime intraday-path stress test

sources.provider: JPX public Daily Reports, locally acquired/normalized in QROS
sources.data_type: Exact OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures contract-level day/night/session OHLC, settlement, volume and OI; continuous daily series also built
sources.coverage: 364 distinct trading days, 2025-02-03 through 2026-07-30; 1,455 Micro contract rows in common day-session corpus; existing continuous build uses 19 contracts and 18 rolls
sources.license_or_terms_status: Official JPX public reports already locally archived with hashes/provenance. Keep raw/local provenance under existing JPX/QROS rights controls; do not assume broader redistribution rights.
sources.jnu_role: Exact-product daily/session identity, roll, contract and regime cross-check; possible daily-grain families only if preregistered before outcome inspection
sources.formal_limitation: Cannot satisfy HAR-RSV 5-minute RV/RSV, FIRST/LAST30, DPD lead-lag, order imbalance, or intraday execution gates.

sources.provider: NDL archived OSE Daily Reports plus JPX public Daily Reports, parsed locally in QROS
sources.data_type: Exact OSE Nikkei 225 Mini Futures common day-session contract OHLC/settlement/OI with all-session volume scope
sources.coverage: 1,250 distinct Mini trading days, 2015-12-01 through 2026-07-30; 14,999 Mini contract rows
sources.license_or_terms_status: NDL metadata/content and JPX report rights remain source-specific. Existing QROS acquisition is governed fail-closed; do not bulk redistribute raw files.
sources.jnu_role: Long-history true-OSE Mini daily/session DQ, cross-era and contract/roll evidence
sources.formal_limitation: Day/session bars cannot be converted into 5-minute realized variance/semivariance or intraday path evidence.

sources.provider: NDL Search/WARP metadata inventory already created in QROS
sources.data_type: OSE/JPX Daily Report metadata manifest with persistent PIDs and access-state workflow
sources.license_or_terms_status: Metadata use and content rights are separate; existing QROS process is low-frequency/fail-closed and does not treat metadata availability as PDF bulk-download permission.
sources.jnu_role: Archive discovery/provenance; prevents repeated source discovery
sources.formal_limitation: Metadata alone is not price data and has no alpha/promotion power.

substitution_rule: A substitute may unblock methodology/current-regime stress testing, but it inherits a proxy label. It cannot satisfy a frozen true-OSE/JNU promotion gate unless the preregistration explicitly permits that source class before outcome inspection.
